messages:
amy: Quick FYI — Friday exec pulse. TL;DR: dedicated availability steady, Private beta on track, costs trending up ~5% QoQ. See asks below. :memo:

sanjay: Nice — can you post the rollout window for Private GA? want to align infra ops.

amy: Planning GA window in late July, tentative. Need final infra readiness by July 8. @sanjay please confirm autoscale tests by July 1.

maria: Product notes: rollout will include two breaking config flags (routing policy defaults). We'll publish migration guide tomorrow. Link: https://internal.redwood/company/product/rollouts/policy-change

jordan: DevEx will pre-publish SDK patch and changelog today. We'll feature a compatibility table.

elaine: Finance: cost increase is mostly GPU reserved fills + spot price shifts. Working on short-term hedging, projecting recovery by Q3.

sanjay: On autoscale tests — running canary tonight across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Will post results here. :gear:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started on infra-dedicated-pool-5 (run id: r-20240715-02). Logs: https://logs.redwood/ran/r-20240715-02

amy: Risk flags: 1) model repo rollout could cause slight latency uptick; 2) billing edge-case for embeddings in bulk. Owners assigned below.

maria: Owners: model repo — @sanjay; billing edge-case — @elaine & @product-billing. Please ack and add runbooks.

sanjay: Acked. I'll post perf numbers after canary. If latency > 15% we'll gate GA.

jordan: Also reminder: console will show per-route cost breakdown after the next console deploy. Keep alerts on.

amy: Asks for leaders: 1) Ops: confirm canary by EOD; 2) Product: migration guide and customer comm by Tue; 3) Eng: perf regression tolerances in writing; 4) Sales/Support: prepare FAQ (top 5 Qs). Put your names on the doc: https://docs.redwood/exec/1718300999-weekly-asks

maria: We'll own customer comm; drafting copy today. cc @support

elaine: I'll share updated cost runbook and a short note for sales comps.

jordan: Quick note — DevEx will add a code sample: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# new routing flag
c.create_route(..., routing_policy='cost-aware')
``` will go out with patch.

sanjay: Canary results: latency P95 +8%, throughput steady. KV cache warm helped. I recommend proceeding to extended canaries.

amy: Thanks — that's acceptable. Proceed but keep canary gating automated.

support-bot: support-bot: pinned FAQ draft: https://docs.redwood/support/ga-faq (please review)

amy: Great work team. We'll recap next Monday at 10am PT. If anything urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

sanjay: :thumbsup:

jordan: :eyes:

elaine: Adding finance note to the doc.
